flow: chain audit (read-only): the app's chain screens on live Sepolia — Market, Cartridges' ENS lines, Open by ENS name, Continent, the save's ENS block, the HUD's ENS chip and a shared world's door chain section. No passkey is linked, nothing is signed, no transaction is sent.
tree: snapshot of origin/main 27e623d (git archive) in $SCR/snap, node_modules and .env symlinked; electron.vite.config.ts renderer section given cacheDir .vite-cache and server { port: 5196, strictPort: true }

env.app: cd $SCR/snap && env -u SERVICE_CHAIN_KEY -u SERVICE_CHAIN_ID -u SERVICE_CHAIN_RPC_URL -u SERVICE_PROVENANCE_ADDRESS OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_URL= UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_KEY= UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY= UNWRITTEN_SIGN_BROWSER=none AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/ud bunx electron-vite dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9346   (UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_* incl. the deployed relay URL and UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_* come from .env)
env.service: cd $SCR/snap && env -u SERVICE_CHAIN_KEY -u SERVICE_CHAIN_ID -u SERVICE_CHAIN_RPC_URL -u SERVICE_PROVENANCE_ADDRESS UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY= UNMAPPED_SERVICE_TEST=1 bun run service -- --port 8797 --data $SCR/service   (no chain env: it cannot record anything)
env.reads: cd $SCR/snap && export $(grep -E '^(UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_(PARENT|REGISTRY|HOOK|ROUTER|ACCOUNTS|FROM_BLOCK)|UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_(RPC_URL|ADDRESS|CHAIN_ID))=' .env | xargs) — only public values; the scripts are chain-audit*.ts.txt copied to scripts/*.ts
